shared_or_similar_visual_information: A colored region delimited by the intersecting contours of two circles. On the left, use the tan lens labeled 11 between Coffee and Tea. On the right, use the green Non-Organic crescent containing 74 outside the Organic circle.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The lens represents respondents who prefer both Coffee and Tea. Right image: The region represents customers in the Non-Organic category only.
Rationales: The lens is inside both circle boundaries, so it requires both memberships. The crescent lies inside only one circle and excludes the shared members.
